profile.name: Tyler Brandt
profile.subline: New-grad data engineering roles for a December 2026 graduate · Tailored to your resume · Board assumes your move to Salt Lake City
profile.recentRole: Micron Technology — Data Engineering Intern (Spark + SQL)
profile.stack: Spark, SQL, Python, ETL pipelines, Git, Linux, Active Directory
profile.target: New Grad FT · SLC (relocating from Boise) · Data Engineering + Analytics
profile.summary: Position yourself as a data engineer who has already shipped production Spark and SQL pipelines at Micron, with helpdesk years that prove you can support what you build. Because your resume says you are relocating to Salt Lake City after graduation, this board treats you as SLC-based and assumes the move; every location and score is relative to Salt Lake City, not Boise. You are not a University of Utah student, so the campus-fair and Utes-alumni angles on the original board do not apply to you; apply through each employer's portal instead.

searchLinks.label: Data Engineer · new grad · SLC
searchLinks.keywords: data engineer (new grad OR associate OR entry level)

profile.applyNow: **WGU's Associate Data Engineer first**: it lists SQL, Python, ETL and Spark, sits in Salt Lake City, and counts a year of education as a year of experience. Then Mastercard Launch 2027 (Salt Lake City seat) plus their Data Scientist I, Goldman Sachs 2027 SLC Engineering New Analyst, and Health Catalyst's Jr DevOps Engineer, the one junior req that fits both your Micron and helpdesk halves.
profile.watchLater: Adobe's Lehi 2027 University Graduate reqs should post in October or November, Zions' STEM application window opens mid-September, and Lucid's New College Grad SWE req historically drops in fall. Snowflake and Plaid post their 2027 new-grad reqs through October.

companies.name: MX Technologies
companies.why: **Watch, not apply.** Lehi fintech whose data reqs are all Senior/Staff right now, so your Micron Spark and SQL work has no entry door here today. Keep it on the list for the SLC move; an analytics-engineer req would fit your pipeline experience well.

companies.name: Goldman Sachs (SLC Campus)
companies.why: **Live 2027 New Analyst reqs in the city you are moving to.** The SLC Engineering track takes December 2026 grads and is stated as rolling fill. Lead with the Micron pipelines and SQL; you have no U of U fair access, so apply through the portal this week.

companies.name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
companies.why: **Strong data-engineering shop, wrong reqs today.** Recursion runs one of the largest Spark-scale data platforms in Utah, but all 14 live reqs are senior computational biology. Submit the general application citing your Micron pipeline work and watch for the data-engineering intern-to-FT track.

companies.name: Domo
companies.why: **BI vendor, nothing entry-level posted.** American Fork HQ and a natural fit for a Spark and SQL engineer who wants to work close to the data layer, but the board shows a single senior req. Set an alert and network here once you land in SLC.

companies.name: Qualtrics
companies.why: **Solid Provo option after October.** Experience Management platform with a real data org, but the live Provo reqs are sales and finance. Your BS in IT plus the Micron pipeline work fits their SWE I and data tracks; re-check when the fall reqs post.

companies.name: Ataccama
companies.note: 17 live reqs (jobs.ataccama.com), all Prague/Toronto/London or senior/sales US. Nothing entry-level in the US today, and without hands-on Ataccama experience there is no cold-email angle either, so set an alert and move on.
companies.why: **Stretch without the product on your resume.** Data-quality platform whose original board fit relied on hands-on Ataccama use; you bring Spark and SQL but no Ataccama, and nothing entry-level is in the US today. Low priority unless a junior data-quality req appears.

companies.name: Sigma Computing
companies.why: **New Grad Program exists but is on-site SF/NYC.** Cloud BI on Snowflake, so your SQL depth is relevant, but the program wants graduation within 12 months and a relocation you are not planning. Apply in December only if SF or NYC is on the table.

companies.name: Adobe (Lehi Campus)
companies.why: **Largest Lehi engineering campus, 2027 grad reqs due Oct–Nov.** The Adobe Experience Platform data org is Spark-heavy, which matches your Micron internship directly. Two Lehi analyst reqs are live now; the University Graduate posts are where your BS in IT fits best.

companies.name: Ancestry
companies.why: **Large-scale data platform in Lehi.** Genealogy matching runs on big-data pipelines, so your Spark work is a real talking point. The Associate SWE req reads like a PERM posting, so treat the odds as low and watch for data-engineering reqs instead.

companies.name: Pluralsight
companies.why: **Nothing in Utah on the board today.** Draper HQ with a data team, but the 21 live reqs are sales and marketing outside Utah. Your profile fits their data and BI tracks; re-check in October rather than spending application time now.

companies.name: Health Catalyst
companies.why: **Jr DevOps Engineer in SLC is the rare junior req that fits both halves of your resume.** It takes 1–3 yrs with internships counting, so Micron plus helpdesk clears the bar. Healthcare data platform where Spark-and-SQL people move into data engineering.

companies.name: Galileo Financial Technologies
companies.why: **SLC fintech APIs, nothing entry-level in tech.** Posts through SoFi's board and the nearest req is a finance manager in Sandy. Worth an alert for a junior data-platform req once you are in SLC; not an application today.

companies.name: Lucid Software
companies.why: **Strategic Finance Analyst I is 0–1 yrs and SQL/Snowflake-preferred.** Hybrid South Jordan, so it fits the move. It is analytics rather than pipelines, but a practical foot in a strong Utah engineering culture; the New College Grad SWE req historically drops in fall.

companies.name: Weave
companies.note: Fraud Analyst at Lehi HQ asks for beginner–intermediate SQL plus Snowflake and Sigma reporting; lead with your Micron SQL work and say you can pick up Sigma quickly. Posted Jul 22, still live.
companies.why: **Fraud Analyst at Lehi HQ wants beginner-to-intermediate SQL plus Snowflake.** Live since July. It is an analyst seat rather than data engineering, but your Micron SQL work covers the stated bar and it lands you on a Utah County data team.

companies.name: Podium
companies.why: **Lehi unicorn, engineering all Senior/Staff.** Generative AI product with 55 live reqs and none entry-level. Your profile would fit an Analytics Engineer or SWE I req; watch the Greenhouse board for one.

companies.name: Snowflake
companies.why: **Your Spark and SQL background is the profile their University Graduate reqs want.** No 2027 req yet and live SWE reqs want 2+ yrs, but the year-round General Software Engineering match pool takes applications now; get in it and cite the Micron pipelines.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.why: **Spark is their product, and it is on your resume.** The live APM New Grad req takes Fall 2026 grads with SQL/Python, though it is a product role in Bellevue or SF. New-grad SWE and data reqs are the better target when they post; Micron work in Spark is unusually direct here.

companies.name: Plaid
companies.why: **Fall new-grad cycle, remote-friendly.** Bank-data infrastructure with real data-engineering teams. No req live as of Sep 1; their 2027 SWE new-grad typically appears Sep–Oct. Fintech is new territory for you, so pitch the pipeline work rather than domain knowledge.

companies.name: Stripe
companies.why: **New Grad SWE req is live and December 2026 grads qualify.** Hybrid SF/Seattle/NYC, not Utah, so it is a second relocation decision on top of the SLC plan. Highly selective; your Spark data pipelines at Micron are a credible story for their data-platform teams.

companies.name: Brex
companies.why: **SLC office is support and collections today.** Data Engineer and AI Engineer reqs are SF/Seattle mid-level. The Salt Lake presence is real, so set a Greenhouse alert, but there is nothing for a new-grad data engineer to apply to now.

companies.name: SoFi
companies.why: **Cottonwood Heights reqs want 5+ yrs.** Lending fintech with SLC-area presence and a real data org; join the University Recruiting talent community and re-check monthly. A solid post-move target, not a this-week application.

companies.name: Instructure (Canvas)

companies.name: Filevine
companies.why: **Analytics team is growing, product req is live.** The remote Associate PM req is product, not pipelines, but a Data Analytics Manager req downtown suggests analyst hires soon. Ask about analyst or data-engineering openings once you are in SLC.

companies.name: BambooHR
companies.why: **All data and engineering reqs are Sr/Staff.** Lindon HR platform that is friendly to early-career hires in other cycles; skip this month and re-check in October for a BI Analyst intern or new-grad req.

companies.name: Pattern

companies.name: JPMorgan Chase

companies.name: Capital One
companies.why: **TDP Associate, February 2027 asks for a degree by December 2026, exactly your timing.** McLean, Richmond or Plano, no remote and no Utah, so it is a relocation trade-off. One of fintech's best new-grad data and tech pipelines; apply if you would move for the right program.

companies.why: **Launch 2027 has a Salt Lake City seat at $100K for December 2026 grads.** Data Scientist I in SLC is live too. Fraud detection runs on the kind of large-scale pipelines you built at Micron; this is the big-company path that lands you in the city you are moving to.
